title: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.19628v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images. Intuitively, iterative samplers such as flow matching are well suited to this task, since each sampling step may resemble one reasoning step. However, in this work, from a circuit complexity perspective, we show that this intuition is misleading. We prove that as long as the model outputs satisfy certain mild regularity conditions, the trajectory of the vanilla flow-matching sampler can be simulated by a constant number of sequential rounds of parallel model evaluations. Consequently, additional sampling steps cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth backbone model under the standard complexity-theoretic model of transformers. translated_title: 自条件化使流匹配具备深度序列推理能力
translated_abstract: 近期研究探索了通过图像生成进行视觉推理的方法，即模型通过直接生成解答图像来解决视觉推理问题。直觉上，像流匹配这样的迭代采样器似乎非常适合这一任务，因为每个采样步骤可能类似于一个推理步骤。然而，本工作从电路复杂度的视角表明这种直觉具有误导性。我们证明，只要模型输出满足某些温和的正则性条件，原始流匹配采样器的轨迹就可以用常数轮数的顺序并行模型评估来模拟。因此，在标准的 transformer 复杂度理论模型下，增加采样步骤无法提升常数深度骨干模型的表达能力。我们进而揭示，自条件化——即让模型以上一步对最终图像的估计作为条件输入——发挥着一种此前未被认识到的关键作用……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文从电路复杂度角度证明，原始流匹配的额外采样步骤无法增强常数深度模型的表达能力，而自条件化机制能突破这一限制，使模型实现真正的深度序列推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proves from a circuit complexity perspective that additional sampling steps in vanilla flow matching cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth model, while self-conditioning overcomes this limitation to enable deep sequential reasoning.
